review_method: Frame-based full-duration inspection: inactive preparation/town approximately every 3–4 seconds; active combat at 1-second intervals; identified critical windows at 0.5-second intervals, with full-screen checks for ambiguous deaths or cooldowns.
scope: Raw per-game extraction only; no matchup synthesis or final cards
validation: All 33 source MP4s freshly enumerated and probed; durations agree with inspection metadata
31 unique flat records with exact V6 fields; one record for each valid game
33 manifest rows cover every source, including both exclusions
All clip bounds within source duration
Forced resources are a subset of observed enemy resources
Loss fields populated and win failure fields empty
Win-condition flags checked independently of outcome; conversion_failed implication checked
Uncertain records and exclusions identified separately
